about: Long (Rachm.)'s loudness along CC1 = velocity = x at several pitches per section, 2026-10-09 (branch rachm-register-curves; tools/soundlibraries/rachm_register_sweep.py has the method and the pitch rule). Windows test VM, real SSO in Kontakt 8 (All techniques patches at library defaults, MuseScore's resaved setups), offline through kthost. 'curve': loud50 (the shipped curve's measure), 'perceived': the perceived loudness peak (the shipped 'perceived'). Checks per patch: the round-robin repeats' largest difference (one round robin: 0), the loudest 0.3 s before a note-on, the latest audio start after its note-on. Agrees with sso_rachm_cc1_sweep.json (4f0e4d93f1) within 0.01 dB loud50 / 0.06 perceived where both measured. Basses: no Long (Rachm.) in their All techniques patch. calibration_from_sound_dynamics.py puts these into the shipped dynamics.json as each entry's 'pitches'.
